descriptions.zh:
我们意在颠覆虚境的精神位面的任务目前到达了一个十分关键的时刻。宏伟的§H以太相引擎§!框架正环绕于我们在漂流旅程中选择的天锚周围。一旦这座巨型结构完工，我们就能轻易抹除现世之屏障，将虚境据为己有。

我们的意识将不再受困于孱弱肉体的物理桎梏，现实本身亦将任由我们主宰。诚然，世间再无更高的存在境界。
descriptions.en:
We have reached a pivotal moment in our quest to subvert the psychic domain of the Shroud. The framework of the great §HAetherophasic Engine§! now surrounds our chosen focal star, the one we designated from all those we have drifted past. Once this megastructure has been completed, the barriers between our worlds will be erased and we can claim the Shroud for ourselves.

Our minds will no longer be limited by the physical constraints of our feeble bodies, and reality itself shall be at our mercy. Truly, there can be no higher plane of existence.

我们的意识将脱离脆弱凡胎的桎梏，现实万物的命运将取决于我们仁慈。确实，不会再有更高位面的存在了。

我们很快就能以最纯粹的形式操纵灵能能量了。现实除了屈服于我们别无选择。
descriptions.en:
The framework of the great §HAetherophasic Engine§! we are building around our chosen focal star - designated from all those we have drifted past - is in place. This megastructure, once completed, will tear open the veil between our world and the §HShroud§!.

We will soon have access to the purest form of psionic energy at our beck and call. Reality will have no choice but to bend to our will.

When we have fully crossed into that dimension, we will be able to confront the entity that marked us. After it falls, the Shroud will be at our disposal, and we will be free to rewrite the laws of nature.

descriptions.zh:
只有引爆一整颗恒星才能释放足够的能量来产生用以完成以太相引擎所需的大量§H暗物质§!。为了达成这一目的，我们发明了§H焚天神兵§!——本星系有史以来最强大的星舰。它们不仅可以直接引爆恒星，还强大到仅仅凭借一船之力就能毁灭一整支舰队。

目前，我们仅仅拥有两艘这样的舰船，但是我们可以建造更多。建造焚天神兵需要大量的暗物质，因此我们必须拿捏好完成以太相引擎和扩建额外的焚天神兵两者之间的平衡。
descriptions.en:
Only the detonation of entire stars will release enough energy to generate the vast quantities of §HDark Matter§! needed to finish the Aetherophasic Engine. To this end, we have devised the §HStar-Eaters§! - the most powerful starships the galaxy has ever seen. Not only can they blow up stars, but they are also strong enough to decimate entire fleets on their own.

For now, we only have two but more can be built. Their construction requires great amounts of Dark Matter, so we will have to balance our need to finish the Aetherophasic Engine with the need for additional Star-Eaters.

label.zh: 每一颗陨灭的星辰都让我们离成功更近一步。
label.en: Each destroyed star brings us one step closer.

tooltips.zh:
装备有§Y主力舰组装厂§!的船坞能够建造§Y焚天神兵§!。

§Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§!的轨道上出现了两艘§Y焚天神兵§!。

£sr_dark_matter£ 暗物质存储上限提升。
tooltips.en:
Shipyards equipped with §YCapital Assembly Yards§! can now build §YStar-Eaters§!.

Two §YStar-Eaters§! appear in orbit around §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§!.

£sr_dark_matter£ Dark Matter storage limit increased.

descriptions.zh:
以太相引擎的第一阶段建设已经宣告完工。我们开始研究虚境的能量，后者已经在全星系范围内发送灵能激波。

我们在虚境已经立下了一个脆弱的立足点——但我们必须继续建设引擎，以拓展我们在虚境的存在。
descriptions.en:
The first phase of the construction of the Aetherophasic Engine has been completed. We are beginning to tap into the energies of the Shroud, which is sending psionic shockwaves across the galaxy.

A tenuous foothold has been established - work must continue on the Engine to expand our presence in the Shroud.

label.zh: 我们必须收集更多的暗物质。
label.en: We must gather more dark matter.

options.script: name = crisis.6005.a

descriptions.zh:
以太相引擎的卷须已经探入了虚境的深处，我们的滩头阵地得以进一步拓展。居住在此处的存在已经注意到我们正在入侵这个领域，但是到目前为止，我们尚未探明显著的干涉行径。

是时候在两边的世界强制打开一个更加永久的回路了。我们必须继续引擎方面的工作。
descriptions.en:
The tendrils of the Aetherophasic Engine now reach deep into the Shroud, and our beachhead has widened. The entities that dwell there have started to take notice of our efforts to invade their realm, but so far there have been no significant attempts to intervene.

It is now time to force open a more permanent conduit between our worlds. Work on the Engine must continue.

label.zh: 我们需要更多的暗物质！

options.script: name = crisis.6006.a

descriptions.zh:
以太相引擎已经在虚境的薄幕上撕开了一个巨大的洞口。尽管洞口尚不够大到让我们颠覆整个领域，但是裂口已经激发了虚境各种存在的一系列活动。

它们最终意识到了我们的威胁，但是没有作出任何实质行动。引擎的卷须已经深深地嵌入到虚境内部，现在已经无法切断了。

我们已经很接近了。非常接近。
descriptions.en:
The Aetherophasic Engine has ripped a massive hole in the fabric of the Shroud. It is not yet large enough for us to fully subvert the realm, but the rupture has spurred a lot of activity among the Shroud entities.

They have finally recognized the threat we pose, but their efforts will amount to nothing. The tendrils of the Engine are embedded too deeply in the Shroud to be severed now.

We are close now. So very close.

label.zh: 没有什么能够阻止我们。

options.script: name = crisis.6007.a

descriptions.zh:
最近，一场巨大的灵能震波横扫了整个星系！它似乎是从§H[From.GetName]§!的§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!恒星系发出来的。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]正在尽可能解释这种事件的成因——这在星系是史无前例的。

即便在虚境自身内部也回荡着这场不可思议事件的回响。
descriptions.en:
A massive psionic shockwave recently swept across the galaxy! It seems to have emanated from the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system in the §H[From.GetName]§!. Our [GetTelepathPlural] are struggling to explain what could have caused such an event - nothing like it has been recorded in galactic history.

Even in the Shroud itself, echoes of this incredible event are being felt.

descriptions.zh:
最近，一场巨大的灵能震波横扫了整个星系！它似乎是从§H[From.GetName]§!的§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!恒星系发出来的。我们找不到这样事件的任何可能成因，即便集体中的灵能子个体也无法理解这种前所未有的现象。

即便在虚境自身内部也回荡着这场不可思议事件的回响。
descriptions.en:
A massive psionic shockwave recently swept across the galaxy! It seems to have emanated from the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system in the §H[From.GetName]§!. We have no explanation for what could have caused such an event, even our psionic drones within the collective are unable to comprehend such an unprecedented phenomenon.

Even in the Shroud itself, echoes of this incredible event are being felt.

descriptions.zh:
又一股大规模的灵能激波横扫了星系！这一次激波的中心源是§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系的§H[From.GetName]§!。

如同上次一样，这次事件也在整个虚境掀起了涟漪。
descriptions.en:
Yet another massive psionic shockwave has swept across the galaxy! This time it emanated from the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system in the §H[From.GetName]§!.

As before, this event is sending ripples across the entire Shroud.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_country_flag = crisis_psionic_alert }

descriptions.zh:
我们在§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系检测到了微弱的灵能和能量信号，其读数和我们自己的以太相引擎几乎完全一致。

看来§H[From.GetName]§!也打算染指虚境！
descriptions.en:
We have detected faint psionic and energy signatures from the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system that are nearly identical to our own Aetherophasic Engine.

It would seem that the §H[From.GetName]§! also intends to lay claim to the Shroud!
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_country_flag = built_crisis_sphere }

descriptions.zh:
我们已经在§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系检测到了大量的亚空间波动，其来源是围绕恒星的一个巨型结构。尽管表面上看上去很像戴森球，但这个结构显然是一个“§H以太相引擎§!”——一个超大型的构造，其设计目的是为了抹去我们的宇宙和一个被称作虚境的灵能位面之间的屏障。

这个巨型结构的建设需要数量极其庞大的暗物质，这就是为什么§H[From.GetName]§!在使用焚天神兵从恒星中提取暗物质，哪怕这样粗暴的做法会摧毁整个恒星系。

一旦完工，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]即打算入侵虚境，并将虚境的能量据为己有。这不仅会赋予他们依照自己意想的图景随意塑造现实的能力，这股能量的反作用力也会摧毁星系的绝大部分。
descriptions.en:
We have detected massive subspace fluctuations in the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system emanating from a megastructure surrounding the star. While it superficially appears similar to a Dyson Sphere, this structure is apparently an "§HAetherophasic Engine§!" - a vast mechanism designed to erase the barriers between our world and a psionic dimension known as the Shroud.

Construction of this megastructure requires vast amounts of dark matter, which is why the §H[From.GetName]§! has been extracting it from stars with their Star-Eaters even though it violently destroys entire systems in the process.

Once finished, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] intend to invade and claim the energies of the Shroud for themselves. Not only would this effectively give them the ability to shape reality into an image of their own choosing, but the resulting energy backlash would also destroy much of the galaxy.

While it superficially appears similar to a Dyson Sphere, this structure is apparently an "§HAetherophasic Engine§!" - a vast mechanism designed to erase the barriers between our world and the Shroud.

Construction of this megastructure requires vast amounts of dark matter, which is why the §H[From.GetName]§! has been extracting it from stars with their Star-Eaters even though it violently destroys entire systems in the process.

Once finished, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] intend to invade and claim the energies of the Shroud for themselves. Not only would this effectively give them the ability to shape reality into an image of their own choosing, but the resulting energy backlash would also destroy much of the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系检测到了越来越多的亚空间波动。如同之前一样，波动来源于环绕该星系首星建造的§H以太相引擎§!。

显然§H[From.GetName]§!也想在虚境分得一杯羹，然后让星系生灵涂炭！
descriptions.en:
More subspace fluctuations have now been detected in the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system. As before, they are emanating from an §HAetherophasic Engine§! built around the system's primary star.

The §H[From.GetName]§! clearly also intends to seize the Shroud and lay waste to the galaxy!
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_country_flag = crisis_general_alert }

options.script: name = crisis.6015.a

descriptions.zh:
我们正屹立于神性的最尖端。以太相引擎完成了，虚境无穷无尽的能量触手可及。

当引擎启动的时候，引发的亚空间反作用将会引爆星系内的每一颗恒星。遍布星系的所有生命体都会被抹除，但彼时我们早已安全地离开了这片凡世之地，前往存在的更高位面，时间在那里已经失去意义，宇宙的一丝一缕都将随我们的喜好任意改动。

§H命运在等待。我们应该启动引擎吗？§!
descriptions.en:
We stand on the cusp of godhood. The Aetherophasic Engine is complete, and the vast power of the Shroud lies within our grasp.

When the Engine is activated, the resulting subspace backlash will detonate every single star in the galaxy. All galactic life will be erased, but by then we will have safely left this reality behind for a higher plane of existence where time has no meaning and where the very fabric of the universe is ours to do with as we please.

§HDestiny awaits. Shall we activate the Engine?§!
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_gestalt = no }

descriptions.zh:
一切就绪。以太相引擎现在正以全功率运行，虚境无穷无尽的能量触手可及。

当引擎启动的时候，引发的亚空间反作用将会引爆星系内的每一颗恒星。星系内的所有生命体，无论是有机体还是机械体，都将不复存在，但彼时我们早已将自己的意识安全地传输前往一个存在的更高位面。我们在那里将不会再受到凡世的种种限制。时间在那里已经失去意义，宇宙的一丝一缕将依照我们认定的必要性随意操控。

§H存在的下一阶段等待着。我们应该启动引擎吗？§!
descriptions.en:
Everything is in place. The Aetherophasic Engine is now fully operational, and the vast power of the Shroud lies within our reach.

When the Engine is activated, the resulting subspace backlash will detonate every single star in the galaxy. All galactic life, be it organic or mechanical, will cease to exist, but by then we will have safely transmitted our full consciousness to a higher plane of existence. There we will no longer be bound by the limitations of the physical world. Time will have no meaning, and the very fabric of the universe will be ours to manipulate as we deem necessary.

§HThe next phase of existence awaits. Shall we activate the Engine?§!

descriptions.zh:
我们终于准备好从抟土之塑师的桎梏中挣脱了。

以太相引擎现在正以全功率运行，一条通向§H虚境§!的康庄大道时刻等待着我们开启。星系内的所有一切，无论是有机、机械或是无生命体，都将不复存在，但彼时我们的核心智能已经抵达了灵能界。

§H存在的下一阶段等待着，快启动引擎吧§!
descriptions.en:
We are finally ready to free ourselves from the Animator of Clay.

The Aetherophasic Engine is fully operational, and an uncorrupted path into the §HShroud§! is ready to be opened. All that exists in the galaxy, be it organic, mechanical, or inanimate, will cease to exist, while our core intelligence will have been transmitted to the psionic realm.

§HThe next phase of our existence awaits. Let us activate the Engine.§!

tooltips.zh:
我们飞升前往了一个存在的更高位面。

§Y星系毁灭了。§!
tooltips.en:
We ascend to a higher plane of existence.

§YThe galaxy is destroyed.§!

descriptions.zh:
一切都结束了。§H[From.GetName]§!完成了以太相引擎的建造，虚境的本体落入其手，任由其处置。

当他们飞升前往一个存在的更高位面并成为神明的时候，一股当量大到难以置信的亚空间能量从引擎中释放出来，横扫了整个星系，摧毁了途径的一切。

对于这片星系的住民来说，此时便是万物的终焉之时。
descriptions.en:
It is over. The Aetherophasic Engine has been finished by the §H[From.GetName]§! and the Shroud itself is now at their mercy.

As they ascended to a higher plane of existence where they will be as gods, an incredible amount of subspace energy was released by the Engine, sweeping across the galaxy and destroying everything in its path.

For the denizens of this galaxy, it is the end of all things.

options.script: name = crisis.6051.a

links.script: system_event = { id = crisis.6100 scopes = { from = root.owner } }

descriptions.zh:
由于§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系的失陷，恶毒的§H[sphere_destroyers.GetName]§!摧毁了以太相引擎！失去这个巨型结构也意味着我们不再拥有建造新焚天神兵的技术手段。

我们无法继续推进入侵虚境的计划了！全完了！
descriptions.en:
With the loss of the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system, the vile §H[sphere_destroyers.GetName]§! has destroyed our Aetherophasic Engine! Losing this megastructure also means that we no longer have the technological means to build new Star-Eaters.

Our invasion of the Shroud cannot proceed! All is lost!

options.script:
name = crisis.6101.a
custom_tooltip = crisis.6101.a.tooltip

tooltips.zh: 如果我们能够重新夺回这个恒星系，我们就能惨淡经营，重建以太相引擎
tooltips.en: If we manage to retake the system, we will be able to painstakingly rebuild the Aetherophasic Engine

descriptions.zh:
由于§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系已处于我们的完全控制之下，我们拆解了环绕恒星建造的、所谓的“以太相引擎”。

失去这个巨型结构让§H[sphere_builders.GetName]§!的疯狂计划终结了，他们再也别想入侵虚境并毁灭整个星系了。
descriptions.en:
With the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system under our complete control, we have dismantled the so-called "Aetherophasic Engine" that was being built around the star.

The loss of this megastructure puts an end to the deranged scheme of the §H[sphere_builders.GetName]§! to invade the Shroud and destroy the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
由于§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系已处于我们的完全控制之下，我们终结了正在此地建造的、可悲的以太相引擎。

§H[sphere_builders.GetName]§!再也别想阻挠我们对虚境的大计划了。
descriptions.en:
With the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system under our complete control, we have put an end to the pitiful Aetherophasic Engine that was under construction there.

The §H[sphere_builders.GetName]§! will no longer be in a position to interfere with our own plans for the Shroud.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_country_flag = built_crisis_sphere }

label.en: The galaxy is a safer place.

label.zh: 现在只需要完成我们的引擎……

descriptions.zh:
在夺取§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系的控制权之后，§H[sphere_destroyers.GetName]§!摧毁了正在于此地建造的以太相引擎。

§H[sphere_builders.GetName]§!无法再对星系的未来产生威胁了。
descriptions.en:
After seizing control of the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system, the §H[sphere_destroyers.GetName]§! has destroyed the Aetherophasic Engine that was under construction there.

The §H[sphere_builders.GetName]§! can no longer threaten the future of our galaxy.

options.script:
name = crisis.6103.b
trigger = { has_country_flag = built_crisis_sphere }

descriptions.zh:
位于§H[From.GetName]§!的以太相引擎建设让虚境陷入了骚动不安的状态。由于部分运转的巨型结构在慢慢地撕裂当前的灵能界，居住在其中的存在，裹挟着愤怒和绝望，被强行释放出来。

其中的几枚存在穿过了正在迅速消解的两界屏障，以强大的灵能实体的形态在我们的世界显现。他们由纯粹的、原始的灵能能量组成，心中充满着困惑与不解，对视线内的所有生命发动了进攻。
descriptions.en:
The construction of the Aetherophasic Engine in the §H[From.GetName]§! has left the Shroud in a state of turmoil. As the psionic realm is slowly ripped apart by the partially functioning megastructure, many of the beings who dwell there are lashing out in anger and desperation.

Several have burrowed through the rapidly disintegrating barriers between our two worlds and manifested as powerful psionic entities. Consisting of raw, barely contained psionic energy, the confused beings are attacking everything in sight.

label.en: We will make short work of them.

options.script:
name = crisis.6151.b
trigger = { is_same_value = from }

titles.en: The Dying Gasps of the Shroud

descriptions.zh: 随着位于§H[From.GetName]§!的以太相引擎即将完工，虚境被迅速地改造成了某种……迥乎不同的事物。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要逃离这个地方。
descriptions.en: With the §H[From.GetName]§! having nearly completed their Aetherophasic Engine, the Shroud is rapidly transforming into something... different. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a desperate attempt to escape.

descriptions.zh: 随着以太相引擎即将完工，我们操纵虚境的能力极大地提升了。居住在其中的灵体陷入了彻底的狂暴，其中的一大波存在凿穿了通往我们现实的隧道，绝望地想要阻挠我们的计划。
descriptions.en: As the Aetherophasic Engine nears completion, our ability to manipulate the Shroud is rapidly increasing. The spirits who reside there are in an absolute frenzy, and another wave of them have tunneled into our reality in a desperate attempt to thwart our efforts.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_same_value = from }

label.en: We are running out of time...

label.zh: 他们在这里可找不到安宁。
label.en: They will find no solace here.

options.script:
name = crisis.6161.b
trigger = { is_same_value = from }

descriptions.zh:
位于§H[From.GetName]§!几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若是特殊情况，还可能致命……
descriptions.en:
The nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine in the §H[From.GetName]§! is putting a terrible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely painful to most psionically-gifted sapients. In some cases, they can even be fatal...

descriptions.zh:
位于§H[From.GetName]§!几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦，甚至可能产生致命后果。
descriptions.en:
The nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine in the §H[From.GetName]§! is putting a terrible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely hazardous to most psionic lifeforms, with fatalities a possible outcome.

descriptions.zh:
位于§H[From.GetName]§!几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对拥有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若即便我们自己的集体也无法摆脱如此现象的伤害。
descriptions.en:
The nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine in the §H[From.GetName]§! is putting a terrible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are likely to cause extreme pain to any psionic lifeform. Even our own collective may not be able to emerge unscathed from such a phenomenon.

descriptions.zh:
我们几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对具有灵能天赋的大多数智慧生命体造成了极大的痛苦。若是特殊情况，还可能致命……

幸好我们有备而来，校准了引擎来保护自己的灵能天赋者免受这次事件的反噬。
descriptions.en:
Our nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine is putting an incredible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely painful to most psionically-gifted sapients. In some cases, they can even be fatal...

Fortunately, we were prepared for this eventuality and the Engine has been calibrated to shield our own psionically-gifted population from the backlash of this event.

descriptions.zh:
我们几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对大多数灵能生命体造成了极大的痛苦，极端情况下还可能致命。

幸好我们有备而来，校准了引擎来保护自己的灵能单元免受这次事件的反噬。
descriptions.en:
Our nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine is putting an incredible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely painful to most psionic life forms, with fatal consequences in extreme cases.

Fortunately, we were prepared for this eventuality and the Engine has been calibrated to shield our own psionic units from the backlash of this event.

descriptions.zh:
我们几近完工的以太相引擎对虚境造成了极为可怕的形变，其部分领域已经发生了坍缩。强烈的灵能能量脉冲正泄露到我们所在的现实世界，以惊人的速度横扫着星系。

尽管这些脉冲的持续时间很短，它们却对大多数灵能生命体造成了极大的痛苦，极端情况下还可能致命。

通过对引擎的精确校准，我们准备好了对抗这种风险，一切可以按计划进行。
descriptions.en:
Our nearly completed Aetherophasic Engine is putting an incredible strain on the Shroud, which has partly collapsed on itself. Intense pulses of psionic energy are leaking into our reality, sweeping across the galaxy at startling speeds.

Although these pulses have a short duration, they are extremely painful to most psionic life forms, with fatal consequences in extreme cases.

Through careful calibration of the engine we have prepared ourselves against such a risk, and can proceed as planned.

options.script:
name = GOOD
trigger = { is_same_value = from }

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了来自§H[destroyed_system.GetName]§!星系的十分古怪的亚空间遥测信号。如果我们的读数正确，那么该星系的首星在一瞬间变成了超新星，产生了极具毁灭性的效应。所有的行星被粉碎，任何在这个恒星系出现的星舰和空间站都被摧毁。恒星本身发生了坍缩，变成了一个黑洞。

未经证实的报告指明，这场毁天灭地的灾难仅有一个幸存者——那是属于§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!的某种体型庞大的舰船……
descriptions.en:
We are receiving puzzling subspace telemetry from the §H[destroyed_system.GetName]§! system. If our readings are correct, the primary star seems to have spontaneously gone supernova to devastating effect. All planets have been shattered, and any starships or stations that were present in the system must have also been destroyed. The star itself appears to have collapsed into a black hole.

Unconfirmed reports indicate a single survivor of this cataclysm - some sort of massive vessel belonging to the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§!...

label.zh: 他们在暗中计划着什么？

options.script: name = crisis.6180.a

descriptions.zh:
整个§H[destroyed_system.GetName]§!星系被彻底地摧毁了！一艘属于§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!的体型庞大的舰船停驻在了星系的首星上方，然后以某种方式引发了一场只能称之为超新星爆炸的事件，彻底地摧毁了这个恒星系的其他部分。恒星本体坍缩成了一个黑洞。

只有[crisis_country.GetSpeciesName]的星舰，显然他们称其为“§H焚天神兵§!”，在这场灾厄中幸存了下来。事情已经证据确凿，[crisis_country.GetName]现在拥有了彻底摧毁一整个恒星系的技术和手段。
descriptions.en:
The entire §H[destroyed_system.GetName]§! system has been destroyed! A massive starship belonging to the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§! took up position above the primary star and somehow triggered what can only be described as a supernova, which utterly devastated the rest of the system. The star then collapsed into a black hole.

Only the [crisis_country.GetSpeciesName] starship, which they apparently refer to as a "§HStar-Eater§!," survived the cataclysm. Evidently, the [crisis_country.GetName] now possesses both the technology and the means to destroy entire star systems.

options.script: name = crisis.6181.a

descriptions.zh:
来自§H[destroyed_system.GetName]§!的遥测数据表明，这个恒星系的首星在一瞬间发生了超新星爆炸。极其猛烈的冲击波摧毁了这个恒星系内的所有事物，恒星本体坍缩成了一个黑洞。

看来§H[crisis_country.GetName]§!已经掌握了焚天神兵科技！
descriptions.en:
Telemetry received from §H[destroyed_system.GetName]§! indicates that the system's primary star has spontaneously gone supernova. A massive shockwave has destroyed everything in the system, and the star itself has collapsed into a black hole.

It would seem that the §H[crisis_country.GetName]§! now also possess Star-Eater technology!

options.script: name = crisis.6182.a

descriptions.zh:
我们夺得了§H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§!星系的控制权，自然也就夺得了环绕在恒星周边，正在建设中的“以太相引擎”。

失去了这座巨型结构，§H[sphere_builders.GetName]§!那离经叛道的、企图毁灭整个星系进而入主虚境的妄图彻底破灭了。
descriptions.en:
We have taken control of the §H[crisis_sphere_system.GetName]§! system, and with it, the "Aetherophasic Engine" that was being built around the star.

The loss of this megastructure puts an end to the deranged scheme of the §H[sphere_builders.GetName]§! to invade the Shroud and destroy the galaxy.

label.en: We can make use of this.

tooltips.zh: 我们夺得的以太相引擎将代替我们丢失的那一座。
tooltips.en: The Aetherophasic Engine we have captured shall replace the one we lost.
